topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't shake the image of your face when you told me. The weight of your words lingered, heavy and solemn, in the space between us. I know you're excited, that part was clear too, but there's a void now where you used to be, even though you're right here. Maybe I didn't show it enough, how much you mean. I find myself thinking of the times we spent, the unspoken moments, the silence we shared that was never awkward. I'll make sure to hold on to those, especially when the distance grows. It's just, things won't be the same, and I'm not sure if I'm ready for that.
